context: Mobile/Web Hybrid App & Emergency Platform for B.Tech Computer Science Project

image_urls.description: Person on chair donating blood in medical setting

features: Emergency Blood Request Creation & Live Status Tracking
Compatible Donor Haversine Search & Radius Filter (5, 10, 25, 50 km)
Interactive Leaflet Map with Donor & Blood Bank Markers
Blood Bank Inventory & Stock Levels Directory
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a fully functional fullstack application with FastAPI backend and React frontend. Ensure all data-testid attributes are included, use Lucide icons, support dark/light modes, pre-seed realistic mock data, and provide demo login pills for easy testing.
universal_guidelines: Never use pure black #000000 or pure white #FFFFFF for backgrounds
Include data-testid on all interactive elements
Support live Haversine calculations and interactive Leaflet map
